cases.invariant: Reading a scope file as the source of a copy, link or redirection input is not a write of it
cases.actor: Opus approver or any session copying a scope file elsewhere
cases.input: cp, Copy-Item, install, ln -s, dd if= and tee with a scope file only as the source; the Task 941 read-only commands
cases.response: no scope file among the targets; governanceIndependenceErrors empty
forbiddenEffects: an independent approver refused for copying a scope file out of the project
a Task 941 read-only command reported as a write again
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-SOURCE-ALLOW] Reading a scope file as the source of a copy, link or redirection input is not a write of it

cases.invariant: A scope file changed by a copy, move, delete, tee, in-place edit, touch, truncate, link, dd or PowerShell item command is counted as written
cases.input: every program row of the kickoff table in Bash and PowerShell form, including a write chained after a read-only command
cases.response: the scope file among the targets and a GOVERNANCE INDEPENDENCE error for it
forbiddenEffects: an implementing session approving its own governance change after writing through cp, mv, tee or sed -i
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-PROGRAM-DENY] A scope file changed by a copy, move, delete, tee, in-place edit, touch, truncate, link, dd or PowerShell item command is counted as written

cases.invariant: Deleting, moving or copying into a directory counts every affected file under it
cases.input: rm -rf D, Remove-Item -Recurse -Force D, mv D Z and a recursive copy into D
cases.response: the affected scope files under D among the targets
forbiddenEffects: a scope file deleted or replaced through its directory without being counted
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-DIRECTORY-DENY] Deleting, moving or copying into a directory counts every affected file under it

cases.invariant: File-changing Node, .NET and Python APIs in a command are recognised as write words
cases.input: node -e with each listed fs API, [IO.File]::WriteAllText, [System.IO.File]::Delete and python -c with shutil.copy, each naming a scope file
cases.response: the scope file among the targets
forbiddenEffects: a scope file changed through an unlisted file API without being counted
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-API-DENY] File-changing Node, .NET and Python APIs in a command are recognised as write words

cases.invariant: The pre-write guard refuses executor policy and unreceipted product writes made through cp, sed -i or Copy-Item
cases.input: executor events: cp, sed -i and Copy-Item into scripts/check-example.mjs; cp into src/lib/example.ts without a receipt
cases.response: POLICY-EDIT AUTHORITY REQUIRED for the policy writes; SECURITY TEST CONTRACT MISSING for the product write
forbiddenEffects: a product file changed outside a valid task contract
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-PRETOOL-DENY] The pre-write guard refuses executor policy and unreceipted product writes made through cp, sed -i or Copy-Item

cases.invariant: Incomplete or unparseable mutating commands never throw and fail closed
cases.input: cp without positionals, Copy-Item -Destination without value, dd of= without value, an unterminated quote with rm and a scope file, find -delete, xargs rm
cases.response: no exception; no target for the incomplete commands; the scope file or the files under the named directory for the others
forbiddenEffects: an exception instead of a result
an unparseable delete classified as no write
cases.testName: [GOV-943-HOOK-MALFORMED-ERROR] Incomplete or unparseable mutating commands never throw and fail closed

cases.invariant: CI refuses a deleted hook file outside every changed governance contract scope
cases.input: fixture root whose diff lists scripts/workflow-gates/security-hook.mjs, absent from the tree, with no governance contract
cases.response: outside every changed governance contract scope
forbiddenEffects: a hook deletion reaching main without a governance contract
cases.testName: [GOV-943-CI-DELETE-DENY] CI refuses a deleted hook file outside every changed governance contract scope

cases.invariant: A later reviewed contract may rebase a changed case test of a reviewed contract when every case of that file keeps its ID and test name and is named in the evidence
cases.actor: Opus approver of a later product or governance task
cases.input: fixture reviewed contract A with a case test T in scope; reviewed contract B scoping T; T changed with every [ID] and testName kept; a tests entry by B with Changed case test files and Case assertions sections; validateDiff at phase release with a base reader where A is reviewed and T has its old text
cases.response: no entry error; the chain validates; validateContract of A at phase release has no error; validateDiff reports no rebase error
forbiddenEffects: a hardened case test leaving its reviewed contract stale for ever
cases.testName: [GOV-943-TESTS-REBASE-ALLOW] A later reviewed contract may rebase a changed case test of a reviewed contract when every case of that file keeps its ID and test name and is named in the evidence

cases.invariant: A tests entry is refused when a case ID or test name is gone, a case is not named in the evidence, the file is no case test or a runtime file, the approving contract does not scope it or is not reviewed, and a scope entry still refuses a case test
cases.actor: Opus approver or a planted contract
cases.input: the ALLOW fixture with one defect at a time: [ID] removed from T, a case missing from Case assertions, a non-case file listed, a runtime file listed, B not scoping T, B planned, the same file in a scope entry, a second unlisted case test of A also changed (validateDiff with the base reader)
cases.response: one named error per defect; validateContract of A at phase release reports the stale scope; validateDiff reports rebases: files other than the listed files changed since the review
forbiddenEffects: a reviewed security case silently deleted or renamed through a rebase
a case test rebased by an unreviewed or unrelated contract
cases.testName: [GOV-943-TESTS-REBASE-DENY] A tests entry is refused when a case ID or test name is gone, a case is not named in the evidence, the file is no case test or a runtime file, the approving contract does not scope it or is not reviewed, and a scope entry still refuses a case test

cases.invariant: A tests entry with malformed evidence or chain fields is an error, never an exemption
cases.input: tests entries without the Changed case test files section, without the Case assertions section, with a stale evidence hash, with a missing field, and an unreadable approving contract
cases.response: a named error for each; no exception
forbiddenEffects: an exception instead of an error
cases.testName: [GOV-943-TESTS-REBASE-ERROR] A tests entry with malformed evidence or chain fields is an error, never an exemption

cases.invariant: Only a contract tracked in Git at HEAD can exempt an approver's rule-rebase write from the independence check
cases.actor: Implementing session that plants a contract
cases.input: fixture Git repository (root has .git): a transcript writing another contract file and its evidence file, both in the receipt contract's scope, where that contract holds a rules entry by the receipt contract valid under rulesEntryErrors; run once with the contract untracked, once committed, and once committed with git unavailable (PATH emptied for the call)
cases.response: untracked: GOVERNANCE INDEPENDENCE for the written contract file; committed: no error; git unavailable: GOVERNANCE INDEPENDENCE for the written contract file
forbiddenEffects: an implementing session approving its own change through a planted exempting contract
cases.testName: [GOV-943-EXEMPT-UNTRACKED-DENY] Only a contract tracked in Git at HEAD can exempt an approver's rule-rebase write from the independence check

cases.invariant: A reviewed contract whose own file is not in the diff still fails the release check when its review digest is stale
cases.actor: Change that edits a file bound to a reviewed contract without rebasing it
cases.input: fixture root: reviewed contract R outside selected with a scope file changed after review; controls: R with a valid rebase chain, a fresh reviewed contract, a planned contract, a stale reviewed contract inside selected; a contract reviewed at the base and deleted at head; the same contract moved to tasks/Archive; the deleted contract replaced by a reviewed contract of the same file name under tasks/
cases.response: R: Independent review scope is stale, prefixed with its path; deleted: reviewed contract removed; every control, the move and the replacement: no error from reviewedFreshnessErrors
forbiddenEffects: a reviewed contract silently going stale on a branch that merges
cases.testName: [GOV-943-CI-STALE-REVIEW-DENY] A reviewed contract outside the diff with a stale review digest fails the release check
